skill.name: File Output with Serialization Schema
skill.description: Writes stream elements to a socket or file using a custom SerializationSchema for object-to-bytes conversion. Use when standard serializers do not meet encoding requirements.
skill.skill_body:
1. Define a custom SerializationSchema implementation that converts stream elements to bytes.
2. Invoke writeToSocket() with the schema to write to a socket, or writeUsingOutputFormat() with FileOutputFormat for file output.
3. Verify that serialization logic handles all element types in the stream.
4. Confirm output is written to the target destination (socket or file) in the expected format.

## Objective

Serialize and output stream data to socket or file with custom encoding
## Applicable Signals

- Stream requires custom object-to-bytes encoding not provided by built-in serializers
- Target destination is a socket or file system
- Serialization logic is application-specific

## Contraindications

- Do not use when FileSink is available and exactly-once file delivery is required
- Do not use when no custom serialization logic is needed; use standard sinks instead
- Avoid for scenarios requiring checkpointing-aware sink behavior without custom schema

## Intervention Moves

- Implement SerializationSchema with serialize() method
- Call writeToSocket(schema) for socket output or writeUsingOutputFormat(format) for file output
- Test serialization with sample stream elements

## Constraints

- SerializationSchema must be serializable and thread-safe
- Output format must be compatible with downstream consumers
- Socket or file destination must be accessible and writable

## Cautions

- Custom serialization may impact throughput; profile performance with expected data volumes
- Ensure schema handles null or edge-case elements gracefully

## Output Contract

- Stream elements are serialized according to the custom schema and written to the target socket or file. Caller receives confirmation that all elements have been processed and output is available at the destination.
